transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’m here because I keep jumping out of my skin at work. A breaker snaps, a tool hits the floor, or somebody comes up behind me, and I’m immediately on edge. My heart just pounds for a long time afterward, even when everybody else has already moved on.
Did a specific event happen at work that started these reactions?
Yeah. It started after the arc-flash accident on that retrofit job. That was about a year and a month ago.
Do you find yourself having unwanted, distressing memories or images of that accident popping into your mind?
Yeah. It’ll come out of nowhere—I’ll see that flash in my head or hear the trainee yelling, even just loading tools into the truck. It hits me hard, like it’s happening all over again.
Have you been avoiding certain tasks, places, or reminders connected to the accident?

Yeah. I’ll make excuses not to go near certain panels or breakers, and I try to avoid those job sites if I can. Even talking about that day—I don’t like it, because once it gets in my head, I can’t shut it off.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient experienced a life-threatening workplace arc-flash accident 13 months ago and presents with persistent classic symptoms of post-traumatic stress disorder: intrusive distressing recollections/flashbacks of the event, avoidance of trauma-related triggers and discussions, and heightened autonomic arousal/hypervigilance.

confirmed_symptoms: Involuntary distressing memories and images of the arc flash and trainee shouting
Flashback-like sensations of reliving the event
Avoidance of specific electrical panels, breakers, and job sites associated with the trauma
Avoidance of talking about the traumatic event
Exaggerated startle response and feeling persistently on edge
Prolonged autonomic hyperreactivity (heart pounding) in response to sudden noises

diagnostic_checklist.duration_verified: Symptoms have persisted for approximately 13 months following the arc-flash accident.
additional_requirements: Exposure to a traumatic workplace accident involving potential severe injury or threat to life
